Body.Content:
Preview the expanded Windows Backup for Organizations experience! In early 2026, if users miss the restore option during the out-of-box experience (OOBE) by accident or due to a technical issue, they can still restore at first sign-in. Windows Backup for Organizations helps preserve Windows settings, the list of installed Microsoft Store apps, and the Start menu pins. And now, even more devices can take advantage of this capability, including Microsoft Entra hybrid joined, multi-user setups, and Windows 365 Cloud PCs. 
 
When will this happen: 
  • The opportunity to sign up for private preview is open now and until February 13, 2026. 
  • First sign-in restore will become generally available in early 2026. 
 
How this will affect your organization: 
Windows Backup for Organizations helps your organization upgrade, migrate, or refresh Windows devices. First sign-in restore experience expands its benefits to: 
  • Those users who miss the OOBE restore option 
  • Microsoft Entra hybrid joined, multi-user setups, and Windows 365 Cloud PCs 
 
What you need to do to prepare: 
Sign up for the private preview now through February 13, 2026. You must be part of the Microsoft Management Customer Connection Program to be considered. Follow links to the official announcement and details under Additional information. 

Additional information: 
  • Read the blog article: Windows Backup for Organizations expands to first sign-in restore. 
  • Sign up for the private preview: https://forms.office.com/r/UbE2AeP1yP.

message.Title: Windows Backup for Organizations expands to first sign-in restore
